verdict.rationale: Reliability analytics are a fair axis for an incident management and on-call platform like Rootly, but the evidence pack documents no MTTA/MTTR dashboards, incident-load trends, or on-call health reporting. The docs cover incident response, on-call scheduling, retrospectives, workflows and AI features. A single community comment says 'metrics looked worse' after incident volume rose, but it does not say these metrics came from Rootly analytics, so it does not establish the capability.
